cohort: 150 women from the Meitei community and 100 women from the Meitei Pangan community in Manipur, India
finding: Meitei Pangan newborns had a lower mean birth weight (2923 +/- 46 grams) compared to Meitei newborns (3106 +/- 36 grams), despite having higher mean parity and gestational age, and younger maternal age.
